svg.text: CI/CD, from a push to two registries
One CI workflow in two stages, one publish workflow behind a gate. Nothing ships unless ci.yml finished green on that exact sha.
FULL only when the ref is main
only a FORK's PR runs anything.
A same-repo PR is the sha its
break with no commit to blame.
by hand, from the Actions tab.
group ci-<ref>-<event>, cancel-in-progress: true — a newer push supersedes an older run on the same ref, main included.
⚠ A sha superseded mid-run has no completed run, so it cannot be released — release the newer one. Nightly and push never cancel each other.
every push · fork PRs · nightly · dispatch
2 - FAST -- linux · py3.12 · node 22 · 13 jobs in parallel · ~2 min, the signal
clone gives it zero — a silent pass
the package as a user sees it
what PyPI only reveals after publish
Python and Node must rank the same
needs: [unit, e2e, build, arm] if: always() && !cancelled()
FULL waits for FAST to FINISH, whatever it concluded — a red unit test says nothing about Windows — but not after a newer push cancelled the run.
Why one file, not two: as two workflows, a push to main started both at once, FULL took the runner slots and FAST's 2-minute verdict took 6 (measured 2026-09-29).
push to main · nightly · dispatch — never a PR, never another branch
3 - FULL -- 3 OSes · py3.12-3.14 · node 22/24 · 25 jobs · the release proof
L7: Python ≥ 3.12 on Linux, macOS, Windows. The wheel
is pure Python — these runners prove it.
e2e runs even when unit failed
A green arm on ONE OS is not a green arm — two libms disagree
in the last ulp. The OS × Node matrix is the point.
each shard runs its third of BOTH passes:
or Python has no graph tier
shard 1 only — N2, graph plane digest
Per push to main: 13 FAST + 25 FULL = 38 jobs. fail-fast: false everywhere — one red cell never hides another. No gate job: the run's own conclusion IS the verdict.
4 - SHARED STEPS -- .github/actions/, used by every job above
setup-python (pip cache) → setup-node if asked → pip install -e .[extras]
inputs: python (L7 floor 3.12) · node (L8 floor 22, empty = none) · extras (default dev)
shell: bash on every step — Windows pwsh would read the install line differently.
checkout stays in the job: a composite action cannot check out its own repo.
junit XML → one ::error:: annotation per failed test (first 20)
carries the test id + the failure's tail to every surface that shows a check.
Why: a session reading CI through the API sees annotations, not logs —

Must read "completed success" — running, red or superseded → ✗ refuse.
Two strikes made it a gate: alpha.2 and alpha.3 shipped on red.
Release tag must match the package
v$tag == fux.__version__ — else skip-existing would "publish" nothing, green
